headline.title: Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven’t progressed as quickly as he’d hoped
headline.summary: Mark Zuckerberg informed Meta staff during an internal meeting that the company's AI development has not progressed as quickly as he had hoped. He expressed concerns about the pace of advancements in AI agents.

articles.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
articles.summary: Agent4cs is a multi-agent system designed to enhance code summarization in large hierarchical codebases, addressing challenges posed by obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation. Unlike traditional methods that treat source code as flat text, Agent4cs leverages the interdependencies and hierarchical information within repositories to improve understanding and summarization.

articles.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
articles.summary: SimWorlds introduces a multi-agent system designed to create dynamic 3D scenes from natural language inputs, addressing the limitations of existing systems that primarily generate static outputs. The framework aims to facilitate the generation of editable, physics-based content, which can enhance video generation and training for embodied AI applications.

articles.title: A$^{2}$utoLPBench: An Auto-Generated, Agent-Friendly LP Benchmark via Inverse-KKT Construction
articles.summary: The article introduces A$^{2}$utoLPBench, a new benchmark designed for evaluating LLM-driven agents on linear programming problems generated through an inverse-KKT construction method. This approach addresses limitations of static, hand-labeled datasets by providing a dynamic and scalable framework for testing AI models on LP challenges.

articles.title: Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis in Non-Manhattan Environments
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced SPG-Layout, a new text-driven framework designed to enhance 3D indoor scene synthesis in non-Manhattan environments, addressing limitations in existing methods that struggle with non-orthogonal spatial relationships. The framework aims to improve object layout patterns, reducing geometric violations and increasing physical fidelity in synthesized scenes.

articles.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable $\mathrm{E}(3)$-Equivariant Networks
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced SpinGTP, a new method that enhances the expressivity of $\mathrm{E}(3)$-equivariant networks by addressing the limitations of the Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) in modeling 3D atomistic systems. This approach aims to improve scalability while maintaining the ability to capture antisymmetric paths, which were previously inadequately represented.

articles.title: Adoption and Impact of Command-Line AI Coding Agents: A Study of Microsoft's Early 2026 Rollout of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
articles.summary: A recent study examines the adoption and impact of command-line AI coding agents, specifically Microsoft's rollout of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI in early 2026. The research highlights the importance of understanding user engagement and output efficiency to avoid costly miscalculations in organizational implementations of these tools.

articles.title: Robust and Explainable 3D Mode Shape Recognition Using Region-Aware Graph Neural Networks
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a robust and explainable method for 3D mode shape recognition using region-aware graph neural networks, addressing the limitations of existing techniques that rely on manual inspection and are sensitive to variations in vehicle architecture and measurement setups. This new approach aims to enhance the reliability of mode shape recognition in automotive noise, vibration, and harshness (NVH) development.

articles.title: TUDUM: A Turkish-Thinking Reasoning Pipeline for Qwen3.5-27B
articles.summary: The paper introduces TUDUM, a pipeline designed to adapt the Qwen-family 27B model for reasoning in Turkish, focusing on both understanding Turkish prompts and providing reasoning traces in Turkish. The project aims to enhance the model's capability to process and solve problems primarily in Turkish rather than relying on English-centric reasoning.

articles.title: AIriskEval-edu: New Dataset for Risk Assessment in AI-mediated K-12 Educational Explanations
articles.summary: The AIriskEval-edu-db2 dataset has been introduced to facilitate the training and evaluation of auditors using large language models for risk assessment in K-12 educational explanations. It contains 1,639 explanations from 170 curated ScienceQA questions across various subjects, including human-written and AI-generated responses.

articles.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced PhysMani, a new framework designed to enhance dynamic object manipulation in unstructured 3D environments by integrating a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. This approach aims to improve the accuracy of 3D geometry representation and physically meaningful forecasting for embodied AI systems.

articles.title: Learning-based Multi-agent Race Strategies in Formula 1
articles.summary: A new study presents a reinforcement learning approach for optimizing multi-agent race strategies in Formula 1, focusing on factors such as energy management, tire degradation, and pit-stop decisions. The proposed method enhances a pre-trained single-agent policy by incorporating an interaction module to account for competitor behavior during races.
